record.question: Sam is the Principal of a good school. His son is studying class 10 in his very own school. He is good in his studies and co curricular activities except in Mathematics. His wife is very worried that he might fail in his selection test for Board examination. He and his wife are worried that if he fails he might slip to depression and that his failure would bring humiliation and bad reputation to them. His wife is so worried that she suggested that Sam should talk to his Mathematics teacher who is a close friend to the family and ask him to help their son by telling him the questions. (a) As a Principal, what can Sam do to save his son from failure? Give at least 3 options. (b) Evaluate each of these options and choose the option that you think Sam should adopt. Give the reasons.
